definitions.explanation: Meat that has been finely chopped or ground, used in dishes like hamburgers, meatballs, and gyoza.

examples.japanese: ひき{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧200⟦グラム→グラム：01354_guramu⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought 200 grams of ground meat.

examples.japanese: ⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ひき{肉|にく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Ground meat is used for hamburger steaks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{牛|ぎゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{合|あ}いびき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ひき{肉|にく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{餃子|ぎょうざ}→餃子：08634_gyouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made gyoza with a mix of ground pork and beef.

notes:
FORMS:
ひき (⟦{挽|ひ}き→挽く：12794_hiku⟧, grinding) + ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧ (meat) = ground meat

WRITING:
Can be written as ⟦{挽肉|ひきにく}→挽肉：14783_hikiniku⟧ or {挽|ひ}き{肉|にく}. The mixed form ひき{肉|にく} and full hiragana ひきにく are also common, especially at supermarkets.

TYPES:
- ⟦{豚|ぶた}→豚：04710_buta⟧ひき{肉|にく}: ground pork
- {牛|ぎゅう}ひき{肉|にく}: ground beef
- {鶏|とり}ひき{肉|にく}: ground chicken
- ⟦{合|あ}いびき{肉|にく}→合いびき肉：22856_aibikiniku⟧: mixed ground meat (usually pork and beef)
